housing-numbers.notes: Total requirement includes 14,000 for own needs plus 1,950 for Luton's unmet needs. Allocated housing includes 7,700 from Strategic Housing Sites, 4,860 from local housing allocations, and 7 Gypsy/Traveller pitches. Committed housing includes completions since 2011, permissions, and other allowances. Broad locations refer to Letchworth Garden City town centre (50 homes).
